verdict.rationale: The GitHub README says Khoj can chat with any local or online LLM, naming GPT, Claude, Gemini and DeepSeek. Agents can be created with their own chat model, which covers per-agent switching. The docs add Ollama and LiteLLM routes to plug in any LLM behind an API, and say models are configurable. Older community comments that chat was OpenAI-only describe an earlier state and are superseded by current docs, so they do not create a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-conversation model switching, named OpenRouter support, in-depth provider configuration docs, and recent hands-on corroboration of multi-provider use.
